SELECT group_invite_id AS groupInviteId, status AS status, sent_at AS sentAt, responded_at AS respondedAt, user_id AS userId, group_id AS groupId FROM group_invite WHERE group_invite_id = #{groupInviteId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_invite ( status, sent_at, responded_at, user_id, group_id ) VALUES ( #{status}, #{sentAt}, #{respondedAt}, #{userId}, #{groupId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE group_invite SET status = #{status}, sent_at = #{sentAt}, responded_at = #{respondedAt}, user_id = #{userId}, group_id = #{groupId} WHERE group_invite_id = #{groupInviteId}
mapper.select: SELECT gi.group_invite_id AS groupInviteId, gi.group_id AS groupId, gi.sent_at AS sentAt, gt.group_name AS groupName, u.name AS leaderName FROM group_invite gi INNER JOIN group_table gt ON gi.group_id = gt.group_id INNER JOIN users u ON gt.user_id = u.user_id WHERE gi.user_id = #{userId} AND gi.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY gi.sent_at DESC
